---
name: Rule change proposal
about: Propose a change to the protocol (anything that affects how games play)
labels: protocol
---

The protocol is frozen per batch (see CONTRIBUTING.md, "Changing the rules"). A change needs evidence and a
calibration batch before it becomes a new version.

**The change** (one line, as it would read in `docs/PROTOCOL.md`)

**The problem it fixes** (games or reports showing it: paths, quotes, counts)

**Expected effect on balance** (who gains, who loses, and why)

**Cost** (more or fewer calls per game?)

**Calibration plan** (matchups, seeds, number of pairs, what you'll compare)
